v: Go get RAJINIfied!!! 😍 Story/logic pakkana petti Rajini style + Anirudh BGM kosam vellandi. Karthik Subbaraj finally gives Thalaivaa the commercial feast fans wanted.
e: Petta is not trying to win anyone with airtight logic or a fresh story; it is designed to celebrate Rajinikanth’s screen presence after a run of slower, message-heavy films. Karthik Subbaraj understands that brief, Anirudh gives the mass moments a superb canvas, and Vijay Sethupathi, Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Simran add extra flavour.
body:
Go get RAJINIfied!!! after all the social message oriented slow paced movies from Pa.Ranjit….Karthik Subbaraj was successful in delivering a much needed commercial pot boiler for the Super Star _/\_

as its a commericial movie so lets not care about logic and story line!!! Karthik was successful in glorifying Rajini’s screen presence and style charisma!!! Anirudhs BGM is asusual terrific and sets the perfect canvas for the superstar to unleash his neverending stylish charisma!!!! Also loved the way director tried to take dig at RSS and BJP in a subtle manner 😛

Though didnt get much meatier roles…..Vijay Sethupathi and Nawazuddin Siddiqui proved icing on the cake with their terrific acting!!! After a long gap was pleasently surprised to see Simran on the big screen and she is beautiful as usual and the romance between Simran and Rajini were dealt in very cute manner!!!!

Rajini’s first dialouge in the movie is “ayipoyanu anukunaru kadharaaaaaaa……..(and there is the Rajinis typical laugh) and looks like it was intentional as though Rajini is facing very low in his career but he is never out of the Race!!!!

v: DISAPPOINTED 😞 Balayya effort 1000%, but 3 hours of movie recreations without enough drama exhausted me. Ee life story ki web series space better undedi.
e: NTR: Kathanayakudu works best for viewers who simply want to relive NTR’s charisma and revisit famous incidents from his film career. For me, the lack of dramatic setbacks, the endless recreations and the difficulty of accepting Balakrishna as a much younger NTR make the three-hour film feel shallow despite his enormous effort and a few excellent scenes.
body:
Kathanayakudu – DISSAPOINTED!!!

COULD HAVE BEEN A BETTER MULTI-SEASON WEBSERIES RATHER THAN A MOVIE!!!!

to begin with, I generally classify the audiance watching a Biopic into 3 categories…

1. People who want to relive the charisma of the person
2. People who want to know the ups and downs in the life of the person and how he/she overcame the challanges faced
3. People who care a shit of above 2 points and watch it as a normal movie

#Mahanati was a classic hit because it had content to cater all the 3 classifications….unfortunately Kathanayakudu fails in that aspect as there is no much failures of NTR after his initial struggle which is essential to create the much needed drame….though there are some 4 – 5 scenes which elevate the drama but the quantity is much less to sustain the drama for the whole 3 hrs long movie!!!!

rather than getting carried away with the awe factor of a Son essaying the role of his real father in movies…..probably Krish/Balaya could have applied some logic that its easy to show case a person in his youth as an middle aged or old man with make up…..but the vice versa is not possible!!!! Just couldnt digest the fact and somehow it was pain to watch Balaya who is in his late 50’s? as a youngster who wants to chase his dreams!!! Having said that Balaya has put in 1000% efforts to make this movie a memorable one for his family, party and hardcore fans of NTR….but some how the movie is missing the depth to cater to larger audiance

The whole Mayabazar Lord Krishna role scene was excellently shot……should have totally avoided Balaya babus self dabba scene!!!only later part of 2nd half was engaging. but the time you reach that point you will be vexed up with endless movie parodies 😦

Finally Watch it….for Balaya and to know a high level glimpse of the stories and incidents which we have already known!!!!

Hope atleast Mahanayakudu…..caters to all the 3 classifications of the audiance!!! till then I am ready to take the warth of all NTR Balaya and TDP fans 😛

v: Shankar imagination ki hats off 🙏 Out-of-box sci-fi idea + huge visual ambition + Rahman BGM... ee scale lo dream chese filmmakers ni support cheyyali.
e: 2.0 worked for me as a focused futuristic sci-fi film rather than a regular star vehicle. Shankar builds the entire movie around one unusual idea, keeps commercial distractions to a minimum and pushes Indian visual effects towards an ambitious scale, while A.R. Rahman’s BGM and the final Rajini-heavy stretch deliver the spectacle.
body:
to start with I have seen many a posts where people are clebrating or making fun of the collections of this film…let me tell you
if this movie fails then Indian film industry doesnt deserve a creative genius like Shankar and he can comfortably move to Hollywood and that would be our greatest loss

How on earth Shankar can come up with these out of box concepts and visualization _/\_ pretty much like Hollywood movie the whole movie revolves around single concept and there are no unecessary distractions and commericial elements……Shakars visualisation is of top notch and it was always a challange for the CGI team to make Shankars dream a relaity. Story wise it is the only movie I have seen after Avatar which showcased Human race in negative and I pretty much loved that concept. AR Rahmans BGM is World class. and Fans get to see typical Rajini style in only last 30 mins.

Wonder what Shankar could have achieved if he hadnt faced challanges with the CGI team

Those who are commeting on the movie comparing with Bahubali….please note that Bahubali was a periodic drama with time and tested formula of Brothers revange ( story wise it didnt had any novality) but 2.0 is a futuristic Scifi film with superb and creative story…..And Bahubali was perfectly packaged and marketed with Business brain of Rajamouli. So stop talking nonsense and hive 2.0 its due credit. Shankar always comes with these unique story ideas (for I he came up with a story of a super successful model turned into a ugly beast due to a virus) and 2.0 on How mobiles make Humans run for their life _/\_

v: Basic story, basic execution... but Nani handles acting, Nag handles glamour 😄 Their combo + good BGM make it a decent timepass.
e: Deva Das has an ordinary plot and equally basic execution, but its casting changes the experience considerably. Nani’s effortless expressions and Nagarjuna’s screen presence give the film most of its charm, while an impressive BGM and regular laughs make it an easy time-pass watch if you leave the logical brain at home.
body:
it has a normal basic story plot…..and basic execution, you neither feel as if you are watching a great movie nor you feel as you are watching a bad movie!!! The director tried to balance between a comercial and message movie…..However the strength of this movie lies in the perfect star cast where the director successed in utilizing the natural acting skills of Nani and superb screen presence of Nag which has proved to be the game changer for this movie. Coming to Nani….Man what an actor!!! he makes it look easy with his cute expressions _/\_ coming to Nag his screen presence is enough and his fitness and handsome levels are outstanding!!! looks like while Nani was busy in taking care of the acting part of the movie….Nag has shouldered the responsibility of Glamour part!!! Nothing much for the Heroines….

Songs wise its again an average…..with evety song being neither good nor bad!!! However the movie has very impressive BGM…..Overall its a Good Time Pass movie with good laughs for every 3-5 mins only if you put your logical brain at home
